class.name: TickSynchronizer
class.brief_description: Coordinates one logical TickSynchronizer multiplayer session.
class.description: Exposes immutable build and protocol compatibility information. Transport, snapshots, prediction, rollback, and reconciliation are implemented in later phases.

method.name: get_build_precision
method.description: Returns [code]"single"[/code] or [code]"double"[/code] according to the precision used to compile the Godot binary. Every peer in a session must use the same precision.

method.name: get_protocol_major
method.description: Returns the current protocol major version. The first experimental wire format uses major version [code]1[/code].

method.name: get_protocol_minor
method.description: Returns the current protocol minor version. The first experimental wire format uses minor version [code]1[/code].

method.name: get_protocol_precision_mode
method.description: Returns [code]1[/code] for a [code]precision=single[/code] build and [code]2[/code] for a [code]precision=double[/code] build. This value is encoded in [code]HELLO[/code].

method.name: is_double_precision
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the Godot binary was compiled with [code]precision=double[/code].
